main.description: P13 VRM ingestion. Validates a glTF/VRM 1.0 binary payload (magic 'glTF', version 2), uploads it to B2 with content-addressed key `blobs/mangaka/vrm/{sha256hex}`, then writes the resolved `vrmBlobKey` back onto the `vertex_mangaka kind='character'` row's `props` JSON so `resolve_assets` (Pregel step 2) picks it up next render. Idempotent — re-uploads dedup by sha256 and the UPDATE is skipped when the blob_key already matches. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_attach_character_vrm.

characterRkey.description: vertex_mangaka.rkey of the kind='character' row to attach the VRM to.

vrmContentB64.description: Base64-encoded VRM 1.0 binary (glTF container). Validated against the 'glTF' magic before upload.

rwUrl.description: Override for RW_URL env (test path only).

vertexId.description: AT URI of the character vertex whose props were patched (null when the row wasn't found or RW was unconfigured).

warning.description: Set when the upload succeeded but the graph write didn't (RW missing, character row missing).
